I have been using this moisturizer daily for at least 5 months, so it is time to write a review. It works great under makeup. It absorbs very quickly with a matte finish. It does not leave your skin feeling bouncy or dewy, but slightly tight and matte. I have oily skin. A lot of primers, skincare, and foundations break me out with acne. This one has not triggered any breakouts or redness. Even though its effects are basic, it is at least safe to my skin. The glass bottle is nice and weighted, and the wider base prevents it from falling over. The only con is the smell the first few times. It has an unpleasant chemical smell that lingered for 5 minutes, but now I don't detect it. I only need one pump, so it lasts a long time. I still have at least a third left.
THE ONLY moisturizer I have used that actually controlled my acne. I went from 1-2 breakouts daily to only 1-2 a week and his was the only part of my routine i changed.
My skin has had a notable difference since i switched to using this daily!
Love how fast this absorbs into my skin. I've noticed the texture on my skin has minimized since using this product. It doesn't have much of a scent to it which I like.

avis.titre: SAVED MY LIFE- ALREADY BOUGHT THIS 5 TIMES
avis.texte: I have never written a review for anything but I feel like it's necessary for me to write one. Before I got this I had tried every product recommended for acne and nothing worked, just made it worse. My forehead was full of a mix of normal pimples, painful cystic acne, and fungal acne. I bought the moisturizer along with the face wash and started using it day and night. Immediately, literally withing two days my cystic acne without a head started purging. I would say you need to know that for about a week you're whole skin is going to purge, for me all of my forehead. Fast forward 3 months my skin is very clear, I get one pimple now instead of a forehead full of them, my face is wayyy less oily. It literally saved my life because my dermatologist was considering putting me on acutane. So, if you don't know what else to try, trust me try this. I go thought a bottle each month but the price is totally worth the results. You will not be disappointed. If you have dry skin I would recommend using a moisturizer as well at night and in the morning spf obviously.

I never leave any reviews but I just have to in order to help others save money. DO NOT BUY THIS. Absolutely awful. It made my skin worse. Painful breakouts. Heavily scented. Worst part is I used it for months to try to give it an honest chance and now I can't even get my money back.
Works so well, my face cleared out in a week. Definitely will be buying more! Have been using in combination with Mineral 89 Serum. Great match.
I used a combination of products but I think this one did its part too. It didn't sting my skin at all even while being an acid. I would recommend.

I had just received this in the most perfect timing! Recently I have been getting the most worst cystic acne every time I get my period. Every month it's been getting worse and worse and worse for about a year now. I have gone to so many beauty stores and I have spent so much money on different face washes and lotions. I received this in the mail and literally after the first use I've noticed a positive change in my face/acne. Cystic acne that I get is not the same as regular pimples so everything I've tried just made everything more inflamed or didn't do anything at all except for this face wash is actually helping to reduce my cystic acne. This face wash makes all the tiny cystic acne bumps go away after a couple days and it makes all the redness go away. It doesn't dry out my face and it actually is putting a little bit of moisture back in. My face will get super oily at first when I get my period and then I'll get some breakouts and then the whole thing will dry out for a few days and then the cystic acne will start slowly going away but with this face wash it makes it go away so much faster! I have looked everywhere for a face wash to help my face and this is one of the only ones I found that actually does what it says and works. I'm so excited that I actually got to try this and it came at the most perfect timing when my face has been at its worst. I would definitely get this if you have any kind of issues like I do because this hormonal cystic acne is awful and painful

avis.titre: Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturiz
avis.texte: This is my first experience using a product from Vichy Laboratories. The lotion is light-weight, gel-like, and absorbs quickly into the skin. It is oil-free, silicone-free, non-greasy, and mattifying. It is advertised as being good for sensitive skin, however, I wish it did not have fragrance added as I feel that would be better suited for those with sensitive skin. Skin feels moisturized but not greasy, and not clogged. However, it didn't feel moisturizing enough for me and I think it would be better suited for someone with oily skin versus my skin which tends to be somewhat dry. I will finish this bottle. At this point I am not sure if I will continue to use, but will decide upon finishing the bottle.

avis.titre: Combats acne, enlarged pores, and blackheads
avis.texte: My skin used to be much more acne prone than it is now but even in my late 30's, I still experience blackheads and breakouts. Ugh! I also have combination skin - oily in some areas, dry in others - so finding that perfect product that doesn't leave my skin looking shiny or flaky can be tricky. The Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Moisturizer is a lightweight formula that doesn't leave my skin feeling heavy or coated. I have been using this for around a month and have noticed some results. Granted, my skin isn't in really bad shape like it used to be but I do have some blemishes and also some minor blackheads around my nose area. When used in combination with the Vichy Laboratories Normaderm PhytoAction Acne Control Daily Deep Cleansing Gel, my problem areas have pretty much vanished. No more blemishes, no more blackheads (which is HUGE), and my pores appear to be considerably smaller. I was getting frustrated at first because I didn't see results for awhile. So, keep trying! The moisturizer is easy to dispense and goes on smoothly. A little really goes a long way. My skin is left feeling soft, silky, and smooth, NOT greasy. Overall, I was quite impressed with this product and would highly recommend it to anyone that is dealing with pesky acne breakouts and blackheads!

his is a wonderful deep cleaning facial cleanser. It cleans deep down into the skin tissues and unclogs the pores. What your left with is a clear radiant complexion, without the skin feeling like it's been dried or stripped of moisture.
